Dear Member,

Meridian Health Plan has completed review of the above inpatient admission. This notice is an adverse determination based on medical necessity. Benefits for the inpatient level of care billed under DRG 194 for the period [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] are denied.

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

The submitted medical record does not document clinical severity sufficient to require inpatient admission. Review was performed by a physician reviewer applying the InterQual-style criteria set adopted by the plan.

Criteria not met:

PNA-02: The patient did not have hypoxemia requiring inpatient oxygen.

PNA-04: Laboratory values were within acceptable limits.

No other criteria codes were applied to this determination.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

This claim has been adjudicated with the following codes:

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

APPEAL RIGHTS

You or your authorized representative, including the treating provider acting on your behalf, may request a Level 1 appeal of this medical necessity determination. The appeal may be submitted by letter or by document upload through the plan provider portal.

Your appeal should address the criteria codes cited above inline, identifying PNA-02 and PNA-04 by code and responding to each finding stated in this notice. Please attach the History and Physical and all progress notes for the admission under review. Appeal submissions are subject to a five page limit, excluding attached clinical records.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Submissions received after that date may not be eligible for Level 1 review.

This determination addresses medical necessity for the inpatient admission only. Questions regarding member cost share, provider billing, or coordination of benefits should be directed to the customer service number printed on the member identification card.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Meridian Health Plan
